text:
Maya: FYI CS escalated CatalystPay — they're seeing p99 spikes on the /v1/embeddings route after a recent traffic increase. SLA at risk if this continues.
Devon: Ack. Any repro logs or request examples from CS?
Maya: CS pasted a few payloads in the ticket. Mostly small-batch embed calls but very high QPS. Ticket INC-3245 created by OncallBot.
OncallBot: Incident INC-3245 created (severity: P1) — assigned to eng-platform. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-3245
Priya: Quick question: are the spikes correlated with batching or KV cache misses? Can we toggle batching for just CatalystPay as a short-term workaround?
Devon: Batching size increases latency at tails for very bursty traffic. We can route them to a no-batch policy per-customer in the routing table. Should be a config change, low risk.
Jon: I can handle canary for the routing change if someone opens the config PR.
Maya: Dev, can you open the PR to add a per-tenant override and include a feature-flag? Keep default intact.
Devon: Will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8912 (WIP) — changes router to honor tenant.override.batch_size = 1
Priya: Also need a short-term runtime fallback: route to a smaller model variant (quantized) when lat spikes exceed threshold. Does that require infra approval?
Devon: Model fallback is supported, but we need to ensure output quality check for CatalystPay. It’s a configurable policy — low risk as long as we limit rate.
Maya: Action items: (1) Devon opens PR for routing override (owner: Devon, ETA 3h). (2) Jon will canary the config in staging and then prod (owner: Jon, ETA 4h after PR merged). (3) Priya to coordinate CS messaging and confirm acceptable fallback model (owner: Priya, ETA 2h). (4) Maya to notify customer and escalate to account exec.
Jon: Ping me when PR is ready — I'll run a canary with 5% of CatalystPay traffic and monitor p99, errors, and cost delta.
Devon: PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/8912 — includes rollback step and feature-flag. CI green. Please review quickly.
Priya: Quick CR request: double-check metrics emitted (tenant_id + batch_override) so we can filter in dashboards.
Devon: Added metric: `routing.batch_override` with tags. Example in code:
```
emit_metric("routing.batch_override", 1, {"tenant": tenant_id, "prev_batch": prev})
```
Maya: CRs: @Jon, @Priya — can you approve within the hour? We want to mitigate the customer's SLA exposure.
Jon: Reviewing now. Left one small comment on logging. Otherwise :thumbsup:
Priya: Approved — double-checked messaging with CS, CatalystPay accepts fallback to `redwood-embed-quant-1` for 24h while we monitor.
Maya: Great. Once canary looks good, Jon — scale to 50% then 100% over 30m windows. Revert plan: toggle feature-flag to false, or revert PR. Confirmed.
OncallBot: Reminder: schedule a postmortem if incident remains open after 72h.
Devon: Deploying canary config to prod staging now. Will post status in this thread.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Keep updates short here. I'll collect final timeline for CS and execs after canary completes.
